acquisition_method.evidence: Here, we apply data independent acquisition with gas phase fractionation (DIA-GPF) proteomics to investigate temporal changes in HCT 116 spheroids every two days throughout 18 days of growth, identifying 6,835 proteins across all samples.

Parallel reaction monitoring (PRM) experiments targeting thymidylate synthase and fructose-bisphosphate aldolase C validate the initial proteomic findings and corroborate the trends observed in GO term analysis.
experiment types: Data-independent acquisition; Bottom-up proteomics
